stations.name: EXXON — Mighty Joe's Gas
stations.notes:
After a lot of searching, I discovered Mighty Joe's Gas (mightyjoesdeligrill.com) which provides Insinger Performance Stinger 91 (www.insingerperformance.com) on pump.

Stinger 91 is a NON-ETHANOL unleaded race fuel with an octane rating of 91 (R+M/2). 

It functions well in a variety of applications to include 8-cylinder Crate Engine oval track racing, Powersports, Small Engines and anywhere in which a NON-ETHANOL quality fuel is desired. 

It can offer benefits compared to pump fuels which contain ethanol as Stinger 91 will provide better fuel economy without promoting unwanted deposits or water attraction.

It is sold per liter and not per gallon.

05/10/2019 - Price per gallon is $5.68

Vincent is the owner.

stations.name: UNBRANDED — Fredonia Mall & Gen Store
stations.notes:
Used to be Gulf branded gas. Same local Oil company when it was Gulf still delivers the same gas although because of some goofy licensing deal it is technically no longer sold as Gulf, but that's really what it is. It is sold without a name. Their 91 octane during the summer only, they call it recreational gas that is ethanol free 100% pure gas. Their 87 now has ethanol in it unfortunately. I don't think they were given a choice. 
Has a Newark address but is really located 6-7 miles North of Granville in the little hamlet of Fredonia, on S.R. 661 which is called North Street Road NE for some reason.  SR. 661 turns into SR. 37 south of Granville so it is about 15 miles directly North of National Trail Raceway for any of you guys headed to or from any car shows with your cool old ride. Lucky that I'm just a few miles away from it myself.
